title: Removal Companies in South West London & Surrey
description: Removal companies in South West London and Surrey compared: check services, surveys, access, insurance and written terms before requesting a fixed quotation.
featureAlt: Movers carrying boxes beside a van outside a brick house
content:
This comparison of removal companies in South West London and Surrey sets out the services each provider offers and what to check before you book. The right fit depends on your property, access, move distance and the detail in your quotation. Start with the seven options below, then compare their service scope against your own move.

This comparison is published by South West London Removals. It compares listed services, rather than presenting an independently tested ranking. Provider descriptions were checked against their websites on 19 October 2026; confirm availability and terms for your own booking.

1. South West London Removals

South West London Removals handles home and office moves, packing, storage and nationwide relocations from South West London and Surrey. It suits households and businesses that want a fixed quotation agreed before moving day, with access and furniture handling considered during planning.

Request a quotation through our website or send a recorded WhatsApp walkthrough showing room contents and access. We assess the inventory, addresses and agreed services before confirming a fixed quotation. If the scope changes, ask for the revised work and price to be agreed in writing before it starts.

For a home move, we plan around the inventory, route through the property and furniture that needs dismantling. Packing, storage and nationwide moves from the service area can be discussed when requesting a quotation. Ask for the current insurance terms, applicable limits and agreed handling arrangements for your own booking.

Local access can change the time and crew plan. A basement flat, mansion block or narrow communal entrance calls for different preparation than a house with a clear driveway. Tell us about stairs, lifts, parking and large items during the survey so these details can be built into the plan.

For a Wimbledon address, check Merton Council’s parking suspension and yellow line waiver guidance before arranging vehicle access. Confirm who will apply, what space is needed and the current notice requirements. Check the relevant council separately if the other address is outside Merton.

Our house removals service covers moves across South West London and Surrey, with fixed quotations after a survey or walkthrough. If you’re comparing quotes, check that each one reflects the same inventory and access details.

2. Removals Expert

Removals Expert is a London removals company that provides house removals, office relocations, packing and moving services. It may suit you if you need both household and business moving support within London and its surrounding areas.

Its service range covers several common needs. A household moving from a flat can ask about packing support, while a business planning an office move can ask how the work will be scheduled around staff and equipment. Match the quote to your own inventory and the work you expect the crew to handle.

Removals Expert offers clear, upfront pricing for residential and office moves. Ask how the quotation is prepared and what happens if the inventory changes before moving day. A useful quote should reflect the size of the move, the distance between addresses and access at both ends.

When you compare this option with a fixed quotation, check what each figure covers. Is packing included or quoted separately? Are furniture dismantling and reassembly part of the agreed work? Ask for the answers in writing, so you can compare like with like rather than relying on a headline price.

Also confirm the service area for both postcodes. “London and surroundings” is a broad description; give the company your exact locations and ask it to confirm the move is within its current coverage. Then check the proposed date and the survey method before you make a booking.

3. Kiwi Movers

Kiwi Movers specialises in removals, storage, shipping and logistics. Its coverage includes South West London, Wandsworth, Greater London and other parts of the South East, as well as nationwide and international moves. It may suit people who need storage or shipping alongside a local move.

The services include domestic removals, man-and-van support, self-storage and long-term storage. It also lists office relocations, furniture delivery, packing supplies and end-of-tenancy cleaning. If you need more than transport, ask which parts of your move can be arranged together and how each part will appear in the quotation.

Kiwi Movers offers a free, no-obligation quote. For a fair comparison, share the same inventory with every company you approach. Note larger furniture, boxes, storage needs and any items that require special handling. The more closely the information matches, the easier it is to assess the quotes.

For moves involving storage or shipping, ask how collection and delivery dates fit together. Confirm what you need to prepare, what the company will pack, and who will manage any change in timing. If you’re moving between South West London and another part of the country, give both postcodes at the quote stage.

Don’t assume that a service name covers every detail you need. Ask for the exact service scope, access plan and insurance terms in writing before accepting a quotation.

4. Burke & Wills

Burke & Wills is a family-orientated removals and storage company based in south London. Its coverage includes South London, all London boroughs, the UK nationwide and Europe. The company handles residential and commercial moves, with storage, European relocations and a man-and-van service also listed.

This range may fit a move that crosses more than one boundary, such as a household leaving London for another part of the UK or a business needing a commercial relocation. Ask which team will manage the move and how collection, transport and delivery will be planned for your route.

If storage is part of your plan, confirm the dates and the steps for getting belongings back. If you’re moving to Europe, ask what details the company needs to prepare the relocation and what is included in its quote. These questions help you compare the proposed service with the move you actually need.

For a residential move, give the company a clear inventory and describe access at both addresses. For a commercial move, ask how the move plan will account for the items and timing involved. The company’s service scope includes both types of move, but your quotation should spell out the work for your specific job.

Keep the comparison grounded in the written scope. A broad service description is a starting point; the quotation and booking terms should describe your dates, addresses and agreed work.

5. GW Removals

GW Removals provides house removals, office moves, man-and-van services, packing and storage throughout South West London. Its service areas include Kingston upon Thames, Lambeth, Merton, Richmond upon Thames, Sutton and Wandsworth, as well as places such as Clapham, Balham, Putney, Battersea, Wimbledon and Barnes.

Its range may suit you if a move needs packing help or storage as well as transport. The company lists full, partial and fragile-item packing. It also offers nationwide long-distance relocations and a video survey. For an office move, ask what the proposed schedule means for access to your workplace during the move.

Local access issues can affect a moving plan in this part of London. Basement access and permit-controlled streets may matter in Clapham or Balham. In Putney, Battersea and Wandsworth developments, building approval or service-lift arrangements may need attention. Mansion blocks can involve longer carrying routes or narrow communal doors.

For larger furniture, measure the route out of the old property and into the new one. Internal turns, basement stairs and narrow doors can affect whether an item needs dismantling. Share those details during the survey, then confirm the plan and any building arrangements before moving day.

A video survey can help the company review access, parking and likely vehicle needs. When you request a quotation, include both postcodes, your inventory and any stairs, lifts or walking distance that could affect the work.

6. Wimbledon Removals

Wimbledon Removals lists home moves, office moves and storage on its website. Confirm coverage for both addresses and availability for your proposed date directly. Ask how its survey and quotation process will account for your inventory, access and any packing or storage requirements.

Before requesting a quote, set out what needs to move and where it needs to go. Include the property type, the number of floors and any large furniture. For flats, describe the route from the front door to the vehicle. If the building has a lift or booking rules, raise those early.

Ask how the quotation is built and whether it covers the full inventory. If you need packing, storage or furniture dismantling, confirm whether those services are available for your move and how they affect the agreed price. Don’t treat a general service description as a substitute for a written scope.

It’s also sensible to check how the company handles insurance and any damage concerns. Ask what cover applies to your belongings during loading and transport, and what steps you should take if you need to report an issue. Get the answers before you confirm the booking.

For a local move, date flexibility may help you find a suitable slot. For a national move, share the delivery location and timing needs when you ask for a quote, so the company can confirm the details for that route.

7. Aussie Group

Aussie Group is a London removals company offering man-and-van services, home and office removals, international removals, packing materials, self storage and container storage. It also offers handyman and property services and works seven days a week. It may suit you if you want storage or extra property work arranged alongside the move. Use your first enquiry to confirm that the company can cover both addresses and handle the work your move calls for.

Start with the basics: tell the company your moving date, current and new postcodes, property type and inventory. Ask how it will assess the volume of belongings and whether it needs a survey. If access may be tight, describe the stairs, lift, doorway and distance to the vehicle.

Then ask for a written quotation that sets out the agreed work. If you need packing or storage, check that those needs are included. Ask about the insurance terms and how the company handles changes to the inventory. These checks are useful with any provider because they make the offer easier to compare.

For a business move, explain the timing that would reduce disruption to your workplace. For a home move, flag large or fragile items before the quote is finalised. The aim is to make sure the plan reflects your move rather than a general service description.

Compare the response on specifics: coverage for your postcodes, the survey process, the written scope and the date you need. Those details will tell you more about fit than a company name alone.

How These Removal Companies Compare

The differences that matter most are service scope, coverage and how clearly each provider sets out your quote. This comparison of removal companies in South West London and Surrey is a starting point, not a substitute for checking the terms for your own move.

The government’s guidance on choosing a removals firm recommends obtaining more than one quotation and checking insurance, reviews and additional charges. Use those checks alongside your inventory and access notes when comparing the written offers.

Cost depends on the move details, not only the distance. A quote can change with property size, volume, access and furniture that needs dismantling.

To compare prices fairly, give each provider the same inventory and access details. Ask whether packing, storage and dismantling are included. Check the payment terms, cancellation or delay process, and what insurance applies. Don’t assume a low initial figure covers the same work as a more detailed fixed quotation.

Reviews can help you judge how a company communicates, but look for details relevant to your move. A review about a flat with stairs may be more useful to you than a general comment if your building has similar access. You can also ask what equipment and protection the crew will bring, and how furniture will be handled.

Licensing and accreditation claims should be checked directly with the provider and the relevant organisation before you rely on them. Ask who will carry out the move, how staff are prepared for the work, and what process applies if something is damaged. A clear answer is more useful than an unverified badge or broad promise.

Pro Tip: Send each company the same inventory, postcodes and access notes. Then compare the written scope, not just the total price.

For area-specific coverage, our South West London and Surrey service areas include places such as Wimbledon, Richmond, Kingston and Epsom. If you’re planning a move from Wimbledon, compare the access plan and fixed quotation against the details of your property.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much do removal companies in South West London cost?

The cost depends on your property size, the volume of belongings, distance and access. Ask each company for a written quotation based on the same inventory and services.

What should a removals quote include?

A removals quote should set out the work the company has agreed to do and the details used to price it. Check the inventory, both addresses, access, packing needs and any furniture dismantling. Ask whether storage is included if you need it, and confirm the insurance terms and process for changes before booking.

Do removal companies provide insurance?

Some providers offer insured moving services, but you should confirm the terms for your own booking. Ask what cover applies to belongings during loading, transport and delivery, and whether any limits or conditions apply. Request the details in writing, then check that the cover suits your inventory and the type of move.

When should I book a removal company?

Contact providers as soon as your likely moving date and addresses are known. Availability depends on the company and the date, so ask directly about your preferred slot. A survey or recorded walkthrough can help the company assess the inventory and access before it confirms the quotation and booking details.

How do I compare removal companies in South West London and Surrey?

Compare the written scope, confirmed coverage and quotation method for your specific move. Give each company the same inventory and access notes, then ask about insurance, booking terms and any packing or storage you need. Check reviews for situations like yours, but verify service claims and terms with the provider.
